title: The AI coding fight just moved from the model to the harness

content_html:
The most expensive part of AI coding is no longer the model. It is the software wrapped around it, and enterprises have started to notice.

The immediate fight is over price. Cursor, the AI coding tool SpaceX has agreed to buy for $60bn, moved most customers to usage-based billing last year. The renewal bills are now landing hard, The Information reported.

The renewal shock

One IT consulting firm paid Cursor about $200,000 for 800 licences in the year to May. At renewal, Cursor asked for roughly $1.5m for the same usage. The firm “played hard ball” and got it down to $250,000. Others tell similar stories. The biopharma group Sanofi and the security vendor Druva both faced renewals about five times higher than last year.

“I may not renew with Cursor,” Sanofi’s chief digital officer Emmanuel Frenehard told The Information. “I get a better deal with Claude Code.”

The flight to Claude Code

That is the near-term winner. Anthropic’s Claude Code is tuned for its own models, and firms are moving spend there. The same IT consultancy expects its Anthropic bill to jump to at least $10m this year. In 2025 it was almost nothing.

The 💜 of EU tech

The latest rumblings from the EU tech scene, a story from our wise ol' founder Boris, and some questionable AI art. It's free, every week, in your inbox. Sign up now!

It is the mirror image of Cursor’s problem.

Cursor discounts where it wants scale, and charges hard where customers are locked in. It has less pricing power than Anthropic. It is not all one way, though. Data from the routing firm Weave shows Cursor bills actually rose less than Claude Code bills over the past six months.

Cursor now offers a router, too, that sends simple tasks to cheaper models. There is room for more than one winner.

Even Claude Code is being bypassed

Here is the part that should worry Anthropic too. The layer that matters now is the “harness,” the software that lets a model actually write and edit code. Claude Code uses Anthropic’s own proprietary harness. Open-source harnesses do the same job, and they plug into routers that shunt simpler work to cheaper open-weight or small models.

The savings are not small. Sapiom, a startup Anthropic itself has backed, swapped in the open-source OpenCode harness and expects to cut its AI spending by 25%. Codestrap, a coding consultancy, says customer costs fell 97% after it built its own platform. That platform routes most tasks to small Google and OpenAI models.

“It’s not about the model anymore,” Sapiom’s Ilan Zerbib told The Information. “It’s about the harness around the model.” Codestrap’s Connor Deeks put it more bluntly: “All the value is accruing to the harness. It has nothing to do with the model.”

Why it matters

This is the agentic-cost squeeze reaching the tool layer. Per-token prices keep falling, but autonomous agents burn so many tokens that enterprise bills keep climbing. Cursor is feeling it first. If the real value sits in the routing layer, the same logic is coming for the premium tools built on top, Claude Code included.

Anthropic reigns in coding today. Its customers are starting to ask how much of that lead is the model, and how much is a harness anyone can rebuild.

content_html_zh:
人工智能编码中最昂贵的部分不再是模型。 企业已经开始注意到它是围绕它的软件。

眼前的战斗是价格问题。 Cursor 是 SpaceX 同意斥资 600 亿美元购买的人工智能编码工具，去年它让大多数客户转向基于使用情况的计费。 据《The Information》报道，续签账单现在正在大幅下降。

更新冲击

截至 5 月份的一年内，一家 IT 咨询公司向 Cursor 支付了约 20 万美元，购买了 800 个许可证。 在续订时，Cursor 要求为相同用途支付大约 150 万美元。 该公司“采取了强硬手段”，将成本降至 25 万美元。 其他人也讲述了类似的故事。 生物制药集团赛诺菲 (Sanofi) 和安全供应商 Druva 面临的续约数量均比去年高出约五倍。

“我可能不会与 Cursor 续约，”赛诺菲首席数字官 Emmanuel Frenehard 告诉 The Information。 “我和克劳德·科德达成了更好的协议。”

飞往 克劳德科德 的航班

这是近期的赢家。 Anthropic 的克劳德代码针对自己的模型进行了调整，公司正在将支出转移到那里。 该 IT 咨询公司预计今年其 Anthropic 费用将跃升至至少 1000 万美元。 到了 2025 年，这几乎什么都没有了。

欧盟科技的💜

来自欧盟科技界的最新传言、我们明智的创始人鲍里斯的故事，以及一些值得怀疑的人工智能艺术。 每周都会免费发送到您的收件箱中。 立即注册！

这是 Cursor 问题的镜像。

Cursor 在需要规模的地方打折，在锁定客户的地方收取高额费用。 它的定价能力比 Anthropic 小。 不过，这并不全是一种方式。 路由公司 Weave 的数据显示，在过去六个月中，Cursor 账单的增幅实际上低于 Claude Code 账单的增幅。

Cursor 现在还提供了一个路由器，可以将简单的任务发送给更便宜的型号。 有不止一名获胜者的空间。

甚至克劳德代码也被绕过

这也是 Anthropic 应该担心的部分。 现在重要的层是“harness”，即让模型实际编写和编辑代码的软件。 Claude Code 使用 Anthropic 自己的专有工具。 开源线束执行相同的工作，它们插入路由器，将更简单的工作分流到更便宜的开放重量或小型模型。

节省下来的钱也不小。 Sapiom 是 Anthropic 本身支持的一家初创公司，它更换了开源 OpenCode 工具，预计将其人工智能支出削减 25%。 编码咨询公司 Codestrap 表示，在建立自己的平台后，客户成本下降了 97%。 该平台将大部分任务分配给小型 Google 和 OpenAI 模型。

“这不再是模型的问题了，”Sapiom 的 Ilan Zerbib 告诉 The Information。 “这是关于模型周围的安全带。” Codestrap 的 Connor Deeks 更直言不讳地说：“所有价值都归于安全带。 这与模型无关。”

为什么这很重要

这是到达工具层的代理成本挤压。 每个代币的价格持续下跌，但自治代理燃烧了如此多的代币，导致企业账单不断攀升。 光标首先感觉到它。 如果真正的价值在于路由层，那么构建在其之上的高级工具（包括 Claude Code）也会采用相同的逻辑。

如今，人类在编码中占据主导地位。 它的客户开始询问，这种领先优势有多少是模型，有多少是任何人都可以重建的安全带。
